stories.headline: xAI launches Grokipedia to build a living AI encyclopedia
Judge approves Paramount buying Warner Bros for $110 billion
SpaceX AI spacecraft will carry 20 percent more power than the ISS
Boston Dynamics built 13-joint hands for the Atlas robot
Small businesses are handing real jobs to AI right now
Rocket Lab signs its biggest ever commercial launch deal

caption:
Here's what happened in AI and tech in the last 24 hours, from xAI building a living encyclopedia to a $110 billion media deal

xAI released Grokipedia v0.3, an AI-powered encyclopedia anyone can help build.
A judge approved Paramount buying Warner Bros for $110 billion.
SpaceX's Star Mind AI spacecraft will each carry 250kW of solar power, nearly three times the ISS's solar output.
Boston Dynamics gave Atlas new hands: 13 degrees of freedom, built for real physical work.
Rocket Lab signed its biggest ever launch contract: 20 missions for Synspective, bringing their Electron total to 47.

AI is showing up in spacecraft, encyclopedias, and small shops all at once. The tools aren't just for big companies anymore. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: xAI, SpaceX, Paramount, Boston Dynamics, Rocket Lab
